_comment: REVERIFY-BANK-1: dated external regulatory facts with no human refresh owner. Per SO #0 (SURVIVES-THE-MAINTAINER), the refresh duty lives in scripts/check-bank-fact-freshness.mjs (derives staleness from each entry's own verified_on, same pattern as data/reg-deadlines.json + check-deadline-freshness.mjs), never in a calendar ritual a human must remember to run.

entries.fact: SIFMA/joint-trades petition to rescind SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05 (cybersecurity incident disclosure) is pending before the SEC; no rescission, denial, or rulemaking action taken.
2026-07-01 remains the latest published effective date for the Federal Reserve Discount Window collateral-margins table; no newer version exists.

IRS Publication 15-T (2026) is the current edition of the federal income tax withholding methods publication; its 2026 Percentage Method tables with Worksheet 1A are what the tool's 2026 tax-year tables follow, and the 2025 edition remains published for the 2025 tax-year selection.
SSA contribution and benefit base is $184,500 for 2026 and $176,100 for 2025, the two tax years the tool supports.

Swift's Standards Releases page lists the November 2026 CBPR+ Usage guidelines (CBPR+ UHB SR2026 final edition released 20 February 2026) with Standards MX Release 2026 live on 14 November 2026, the rule set the tool's CBPR+ validation follows.
